corpus_identity.layout: flat directory; one CSV per symbol/timeframe named {SYMBOL}_{TF}.csv; columns time,open,high,low,close,volume; time is Unix seconds (UTC).
corpus_identity.version_build_marker: market_data_manifest.json (generated_at 2026-11-02T02:02:00Z, generated_by scripts.market_data_manifest); no README or git repository in corpus-store.

extraction_method: Read-only: Python csv.DictReader over ~/corpus-store/{SYMBOL}_{TF}.csv; timestamps parsed as int Unix seconds and converted to UTC with datetime.fromtimestamp(..., timezone.utc). No writes to corpus.

timestamp_convention.evidence: D1 bar open price equals the H1 bar open price at 00:00 UTC on the same date (e.g. GOLD 2024-07-02 D1 open 2332.13 == GOLD H1 2024-07-02T00:00 open 2332.13); D1 bars open at 00:00:00Z and increment by 1 day; H1/H4 opens align to wall-clock market-open hours rather than midnight close boundaries.

d1_boundary.close_instant_utc: 00:00:00Z on the following calendar day (D1 open 00:00:00Z + 1 day)
d1_boundary.birth_coincidence_case: daily case (D1 close coincides with an H1 bar open at 00:00Z every day)

dst_transitions_in_candidate_span.transition: EU DST ended 2026-10-25 (clocks back one hour)
dst_transitions_in_candidate_span.representation: Corpus represents DST by shifted bar-open hours: H1 2026-10-22 had 24 bars (extra hour), 2026-10-23 missing hour 01, 2026-10-26 missing hours 00-01; H4 slots shifted from 00/04/... to 01/05/... after the transition. No D1 impact; counts handled per trading day.
